params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: landing-feedback  Priority: P3  Area: site
Summary: The landing page has no testimonials, which the referenced landing-page guidance recommends. Until there are clients to quote, find another way to earn trust quickly, for example the team's combined experience in Web3 and in regulated trust services.

## What is asked
- Skip testimonials for now, or replace them with a credible signal of the team's track record.
- No invented quotes or logos; every claim needs a source.

Source: Portal mail:6 (feedback on the website content, forwarded by the owner). The client asks for the owner's view first, so this is a proposal to agree on before building.
params.title: Earn trust on the landing page without testimonials
